# `noya research`

_Sandboxed auto research loops — sessions, run code, getRun/cancel._

**6 commands** in this group.

### `noya research cancel-run`

Cancel a running run — a control-plane kill → status `killed` (write)

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--run-id` | `<value>` | — | Run id to cancel (control-plane kill). |

### `noya research capabilities`

Public provider/runtime discovery — registered sandbox providers + the default termination-triad bounds (TTL / idle / cost). No auth needed (read); mirrors `predict.capabilities()`

_No flags._

### `noya research create-session`

Create a research session pinned to an `as_of` timestamp (write)

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--as-of` | `<value>` | — | ISO 8601 backtest pin. The broker clamps every sandbox data read to ≤ this, so lookahead/survivorship bias is structurally impossible. Must not be in the future. |

### `noya research get-run`

Fetch a run's status, reason, last progress checkpoint, self-reported metrics, log tail, partial ledger, and exit reason (read). This is what the calling agent reads to decide whether to rewrite-and-rerun

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--run-id` | `<value>` | — | Run id from `runCode`. |

### `noya research list-runs`

List the caller's runs, optionally filtered to one session (read)

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--session-id` | `<value>` | — | Filter to one session. Omit to list all the caller's runs. |

### `noya research run-code`

Start a sandbox and run strategy/backtest code in it (write)

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--session-id` | `<value>` | — | Session id from `createSession`. |
| `--code` | `<value>` | — | Python strategy/backtest code. Runs in an isolated sandbox with the baked-in `noya` lib (`noya.data.*` as_of-clamped reads, `noya.backtest.Backtest`, `noya.log`); it cannot reach the internet except through the broker. |
| `--provider` | `<value>` | — | Sandbox provider (default: the server's only v1 provider, E2B). |
